welcomeBody: Ɗu'um waɗata duuɓi seɗɗa: Novera e sooda inference engine maagal e moodel pamari ngam heɓtoyki fiiji. Ɗum waaway naftirki kompuuta maagal nde ɗum huuwata.
otherWarnings: {{count}} Ɗuuɗal foonduɗe ɗen maa e ngoodi haaje hakkilanki maagal.
setupDoneBody: Novera e huuwa moodelji nokkuure e llama.cpp.
dsparkDescription: Hawta DSpark Q8_0 companion ({{size}}) ngam LFM2.5-2.6B. Ɗu'um waaway ɓesda jahal yeeso, amma naftira ɓeydaande RAM maabo VRAM, ɓesda heedi hakkilanki haalaji.
